answer: Oasis signal posts force every job into the open a day before it starts. An alias posts a signal at a public oasis board 24 hours before a job, naming the client, the fee, and the start time. The crystal record keeps every signal visible for 90 days for any reader to check. A client cannot pay for a job with no matching signal, so hidden work earns nothing. Two aliases posting signals for the same job, or one working without a signal, triggers review by 3 veteran readers. A confirmed violation voids the job pay and bars the alias from new jobs for 10 days.
